name: Gentiles
overview: The Scriptures reveal that the Gentiles, or nations outside Israel, are included in God's redemptive plan through the promised blessing in Abraham's seed, which extends to all families of the earth. This promise, first given in Genesis, finds its fulfillment as God calls the nations to Himself, granting Christ the heathen as His inheritance and the ends of the earth as His possession. Though often depicted as a foolish and idolatrous people, the Gentiles are destined to be gathered and blessed through the Messiah, underscoring God's sovereign purpose to extend salvation beyond Israel.
